prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.canonicalPath = function(base, segments)
Behavior: Join a base absolute slash path and relative path segments. Ignore empty and dot segments, resolve dot-dot without escaping root, collapse repeated slashes, and return null/None/error marker for a non-absolute base or an attempted root escape. The root result is '/'.
Visible example: base /a/b with segments ../c, ./d becomes /a/c/d; base / with .. is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const f=(b,s)=>{if(!b.startsWith('/'))return null;const p=[];for(const r of[b,...s])for(const x of r.split('/')){if(!x||x==='.')continue;if(x==='..'){if(!p.length)return null;p.pop()}else p.push(x)}return'/'+p.join('/')};exports.canonicalPath=f;
